thread: Follow a puppet from the workshop to the stage and into the worlds a performance can conjure. The swarm meets jointed figures and their strings, costumes and scenery, then the masks and characters of theatre.

candidates.name: Museu da Marioneta
candidates.why: Portuguese Robertos, shadow figures, rod puppets and stop-motion characters offer a menagerie of bodies and ways to move.

candidates.name: Swedish Museum of Performing Arts
candidates.why: Hand puppets and marionettes share the collection with stage models, theatrical props and costumes that can become a whole miniature production.

candidates.name: Tsubouchi Memorial Theatre Museum
candidates.why: Japanese and world theatre collections open onto kabuki characters, stage costumes, theatrical prints and the expressive worlds of noh and bunraku.

candidates.name: Antonio Pasqualino International Puppet Museum
candidates.why: Sicilian pupi, international puppets, theatrical machines and scenery suggest armored figures and imaginative stage creatures.

candidates.name: Gadagne Museums
candidates.why: Lyon's puppetry museum brings Guignol and puppets from around the world into a setting of characters, stories and performance spaces.

candidates.name: Theatre Museum Finland
candidates.why: Puppet theatre materials, costumes, props, stage models and theatre technology provide parts for a backstage swarm.

candidates.name: Scottish Mask and Puppet Centre
candidates.why: Masks and puppets include shadow figures from several traditions and giant theatrical characters, with exhibitions and productions to explore.

candidates.name: Victoria and Albert Museum
candidates.why: Its theatre and performance material includes puppets, stage costumes, set designs and props, from shadow figures to a life-sized horse puppet.

candidates.name: Harry Ransom Center
candidates.why: Performing arts collections hold rod and shadow puppets alongside scenic designs, models and the tools of stagecraft.

candidates.name: Columbia University Libraries Online Exhibitions
candidates.why: The Dramatic Museum exhibition contains shadow puppets, masks, model theatres and stage sets for a small world of performers.
